name: Open
description: The first clip splits down the middle and both halves swing open in perspective while the second clip comes forward from the distance over a floor reflection. Recreation of the CapCut "Open" transition. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: overlap
params.description: false (default) = like CapCut: the first clip plays both roles for the first half, the second clip for the second half (the picture jumps at the midpoint). true = the first clip opens onto the second one all the way through
